mission.display_title: Construct estimators by the method of moments
mission.mission_purpose: Today's Mission exists to construct estimators of population parameters by the method of moments — so the MoM move is usable — without pretending maximum likelihood (3.1.2) is finished.
mission.tutor_intent: Today I will force the candidate to equate sample moments to population moments and solve for the parameter — and refuse treating 'I wrote an estimator' as having the MoM LO.
mission.educational_intent: Produce a cognitive move from population moments to a method-of-moments estimator under CMP language.
mission.learning_objective: Method of moments for constructing estimators of population parameters.
mission.concept_focus: Population moments → sample moments → solve for parameter → refuse MLE-as-done.

knowledge_checks.title: Active Recall: 3.1.1
knowledge_checks.prompt: Closed-book. (1) What is the method-of-moments construction move? (2) What replaces population moments in the equations? (3) Name one reason 'I have a formula for θ̂' is not automatically MoM.
hints: Use CMP language from today's notes.
knowledge_checks.model_answer: Method of moments equates sample moments to the corresponding population moments (as functions of parameters) and solves for the parameter(s). Having any estimator formula is not the same as using that moment-matching move.
knowledge_checks.common_mistake: Skipping the LO hinge or swallowing the next LO.

knowledge_checks.title: Checkpoint: 3.1.1

knowledge_checks.model_answer: Refuse: MLE is tomorrow's LO. Today requires the method-of-moments construction — equate sample and population moments and solve.
